name: Eligibility Blocked vs Override
query:
select
	e.overall_status,
	count(*) as evaluations,
	sum(case when e.can_submit = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as proceeded,
	sum(case when e.can_submit = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as blocked,
	sum(case when e.overridden_by is not null and e.overridden_by != '' then 1 else 0 end) as overridden,
	sum(case when e.overridden_by is not null and e.overridden_by != '' and cl.status in ('Approved', 'Partially Approved', 'Settled') then 1 else 0 end) as override_then_approved
from `tabClaim Eligibility Evaluation` e
left join `tabInsurance Claim` cl on cl.name = e.insurance_claim
group by e.overall_status
order by evaluations desc
